# ms: # One successful turn in a TUI session, from process start.
# session_start carries reason=startup and ctx.mode=tui, which is the gate the
# asset checks instead of hasUI: an RPC session reports hasUI true while being
# headless. ctx.sessionFile and ctx.sessionId are both present, so the pane can
# be bound to its transcript by path.
# The lane comes from agent_start (work start) and agent_settled (turn
# complete), and nothing else. Note what the intermediate rows show about why:
# ctx.isIdle is false on agent_end and true on agent_settled, three milliseconds
# apart. An asset that closed the turn on agent_end would report idle while Pi
# still considers the run active, which is exactly the trap the shipped asset's
# isIdle !== true guard exists for. turn_end is equally unusable as turn
# completion; see tool-turn.tsv, where two turn_end rows arrive inside one run.
